fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Alerts for answers that need a person

Alert the staff member who owns an answer by email or in Slack once it arrives. A plan outside the accepted list goes to billing; a referral sent without labs goes to scheduling.
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Decide which answers need a person before the visit: an insurance plan you do not accept, a missing referral, a symptom the nurse wants flagged. Name one staff member for each, and choose whether they hear about it by email or in Slack.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a new patient intake form for my family practice.
